verses.sloka: शुनःशेपम् नरश्रेष्ठ गृहीत्वा तु महायशाः ।व्यश्रामत् पुष्करे राजा मध्याह्ने रघुनंदन ॥१-६२-१॥
verses.transliteration: śunaḥśepam naraśreṣṭha gṛhītvā tu mahāyaśāḥ ।vyaśrāmat puṣkare rājā madhyāhne raghunaṁdana ॥1-62-1॥

translations.english: O Foremost of men, O Delight of the Raghus (Rama) the illustrious king (Ambarisha) took Sunassepha with him. (On the way) at Pushkara he took some rest at noon.

verses.transliteration: tasya viśramamāṇasya śunaḥśepo mahāyaśāḥ ।puṣkaram jyeṣṭham āgamya viśvāmitram dadarśa ha ॥1-62-2॥

translations.english: While the king was resting at Pushkara, the famous Sunassepha, very much distressed, happened to see his maternal uncle Viswamitra in the company of other sages performing austerities.

verses.transliteration: papāta anke mune rāma vākyam ca idam uvāca ha ।na me asti mātā na pitā jñātayo bāndhavāḥ kutaḥ ॥1-62-4॥

translations.english: "O Noble man O Preeminent among ascetics I have no mother nor father nor friends nor relatives. You should protect me according to dharma.

verses.transliteration: trātum arhasi mām saumya dharmeṇa munipuṁgava ।trātā tvam hi naraśreṣṭha sarveṣām tvam hi bhāvanaḥ ॥1-62-5॥

translations.english: O Best among ascetics you are the protecor of everybody. You are promoter of others' welfare. May the king fulfil his purpose. May I live long and become immortal and attain heaven after performing great penance. May I enjoy heaven.
translations.hindi: , er EI TR जा” शा आ ०१ ९ हू [ नोट--वसिष्ठ जी के पुत्रों के क्रुद्ध होने का कारण यही था | उना लोगों मे समका कि, त्रिशंकु हमारे और हमारे पिता फे बीच वैर करवाना चाहता है । यही बात वे यहाँ कह रहे हैं । ] बालिशस्त्वं नरश्रेष्ठ गम्यतां स्वपुरं पुनः । याजने भगवाञ्शक्तस्त्रैलोक्यस्यापि पार्थिव

verses.transliteration: rājā ca kṛtakāryaḥ syāt aham dīrgha āyuḥ avyayaḥ ।svarga lokam upāśnīyām tapaḥ taptvā hi anuttamam ॥1-62-6॥

translations.english: O Best among ascetics you are the protecor of everybody. You are promoter of others' welfare. May the king fulfil his purpose. May I live long and become immortal and attain heaven after performing great penance. May I enjoy heaven.

translations.english: O Virtuous one with a kind heart protect this orphan. Like a father who protects his son, save me from this peril".

translations.english: Having heard Sunassepha, mighty ascetic Viswamitra consoled him in many ways and said to his sons:

verses.sloka: यत् कृते पितरः पुत्रान् जनयन्ति शुभ अर्थिनः ।पर लोक हित अर्थाय तस्य कालो अयम् आगतः ॥१-६२-९॥

translations.english: The very time has now come for that purpose for which parents desiring auspiciousness beget sons—namely, for their welfare in the other world.

verses.sloka: अयम् मुनि सुतो बालो मत्तः शरणम् इच्छति ।अस्य जीवित मात्रेण प्रियम् कुरुत पुत्रकाः ॥१-६२-१०॥
verses.transliteration: ayam muni suto bālo mattaḥ śaraṇam icchati ।asya jīvita mātreṇa priyam kuruta putrakāḥ ॥1-62-10॥

translations.english: O sons of the sage this young boy has sought my protection. O Sons you may grant him his desire by merely offering your life.

translations.english: Engaged in the observance of righteousness, all of you have done virtuous deeds. By becoming sacrificial animals for the king, you may satisfy Agni.

verses.sloka: नाथनान् च शुनःशेपो यज्ञः च अविघ्नतो भवेत् ।देवताः तर्पिताः च स्युः मम च अपि कृतम् वचः ॥१-६२-१२॥

translations.english: Then Sunassepha will be protected. The king's sacrifice will continue without hindrance. The gods will be gratified. My words also will come true".

verses.sloka: मुनेः तु वचनम् श्रुत्वा मधुष्यन्द आदयः सुताः ।स अभिमानम् नरश्रेष्ठ स लीलम् इदम् अब्रुवन् ॥१-६२-१३॥
verses.transliteration: muneḥ tu vacanam śrutvā madhuṣyanda ādayaḥ sutāḥ ।sa abhimānam naraśreṣṭha sa līlam idam abruvan ॥1-62-13॥

translations.english: "O Best of men (Rama) in response to the words of the sage Madhuchanda and others said thus in a casual way with selfesteem.

verses.transliteration: katham ātma sutān hitvā trāyase anya sutam vibho ।akāryam iva paśyāmaḥ śva māṁsam iva bhojane ॥1-62-14॥

translations.english: O Lord protecting other's son by abandoning one' own is like partaking the flesh of a dog. We consider it a prohibited act".
translations.hindi: अर चाण्डाल को प्राप्त हुआ देख, उस पर दया आई । दयावश, महातेजस्त्री और परम धार्मिक विश्वामित्र जी ने

translations.english: On hearing the words of his sons Viswamitra, the eminent ascetic, eyes reddened with anger began to speak:

translations.english: "(You have) not only trangressed my words but also (you are) censurable according to dharma. You have uttered such audacious and dreadrul words causing the hair to stand on end.

verses.sloka: श्व मांस भोजिनः सर्वे वासिष्ठा इव जातिषु ।पूर्णम् वर्ष सहस्रम् तु पृथिव्याम् अनुवत्स्यथ ॥१-६२-१७॥
verses.transliteration: śva māṁsa bhojinaḥ sarve vāsiṣṭhā iva jātiṣu ।pūrṇam varṣa sahasram tu pṛthivyām anuvatsyatha ॥1-62-17॥

verses.transliteration: kṛtvā śāpa samāyuktān putrān munivaraḥ tadā ।śunaḥśepam uvāca ārtam kṛtvā rakṣām nirāmayām ॥1-62-18॥

translations.english: Viswamitra the best of ascetics, thus cursed his sons. Sunassepha, (now) was filled with distress. To relieve him of his pain he said:

verses.sloka: पवित्र पाशैर् बद्धो रक्त माल्य अनुलेपनः ।वैष्णवम् यूपम् आसाद्य वाग्भिः अग्निम् उदाहर ॥१-६२-१९॥
verses.transliteration: pavitra pāśair baddho rakta mālya anulepanaḥ ।vaiṣṇavam yūpam āsādya vāgbhiḥ agnim udāhara ॥1-62-19॥

translations.english: "Bedaubing your person with red sandal paste and adorned with red garlands, you will be bound to a Vaishnava, sacrificial post with sacred ropes. There invoke Agni with these hymns.

verses.sloka: इमे च गाथे द्वे दिव्ये गायेथा मुनि पुत्रक ।अंबरीषस्य यज्ञे अस्मिन् ततः सिद्धिम् अवाप्स्यसि ॥१-६२-२०॥
verses.transliteration: ime ca gāthe dve divye gāyethā muni putraka ।aṁbarīṣasya yajñe asmin tataḥ siddhim avāpsyasi ॥1-62-20॥

translations.english: O Son of sage chant thse two sacred mantras in the sacrifice of Ambarisha.There after you will achieve success (long life)".
translations.hindi: भले ही मुझ पर म्ही ही क्यों न पड़े, में क्षात्रधर्म की शपथ खा कर कहता हूँ, मैंने अनेक यज्ञ किए, धर्म पूर्व पालन किया

verses.sloka: शुनःशेपो गृहीत्वा ते द्वे गाथे सुसमाहितः ।त्वरया राज सिंहम् तम् अंबरीषम् उवाच ह ॥१-६२-२१॥
verses.transliteration: śunaḥśepo gṛhītvā te dve gāthe susamāhitaḥ ।tvarayā rāja siṁham tam aṁbarīṣam uvāca ha ॥1-62-21॥

translations.english: Sunassepha memorized the two verses with concentration of mind and hastened towards Amabarisha, a lion among kings. And said:

verses.sloka: राज सिंह महाबुद्धे शीघ्रम् गच्छावहे वयम् ।निवर्तयस्व राजेन्द्र दीक्षाम् च समुदाहर ॥१-६२-२२॥
verses.transliteration: rāja siṁha mahābuddhe śīghram gacchāvahe vayam ।nivartayasva rājendra dīkṣām ca samudāhara ॥1-62-22॥

translations.english: "Endowed with great strength, you are a lion among kings. We shall go to the sacrificial assembly without delay. O Indra among monarchs, take up initiatory rites and perform the sacrifice".
translations.hindi: हे मुनिपुङ्गव ! परन्तु गुरु लोग राजी न हुए। सो हे मने ! में सो भाग्य ही को प्रबल मानता हुँ, पुरुषार्थ कुछ भी नहीं है

verses.sloka: तत् वाक्यम् ऋषि पुत्रस्य श्रुत्वा हर्ष समन्वितः ।जगाम नृपतिः शीघ्रम् यज्ञ वाटम् अतन्द्रितः ॥१-६२-२३॥
verses.transliteration: tat vākyam ṛṣi putrasya śrutvā harṣa samanvitaḥ ।jagāma nṛpatiḥ śīghram yajña vāṭam atandritaḥ ॥1-62-23॥

translations.english: At the words of the sage's son, the king, eager with delight hastened towards the sacrificial ground.
translations.hindi: जो कुछ होता है वह भाग्य ही से होता है | भाग्य ही सब कुछ है । सो मुझ परमदीन हतभाग्य पर, आप कृपा कीजिए । आपका मङ्गल हो

verses.sloka: सदस्य अनुमते राजा पवित्र कृत लक्षणम् ।पशुम् रक्त अंबरम् कृत्वा यूपे तम् समबन्धयत् ॥१-६२-२४॥
verses.transliteration: sadasya anumate rājā pavitra kṛta lakṣaṇam ।paśum rakta aṁbaram kṛtvā yūpe tam samabandhayat ॥1-62-24॥

translations.english: With the consent of the officiating priests the king invested Sunasepha with the sacred symbols with Kusa grass, dressed him in red apparel and tied him to the sacrificial post as a sacrificial animal.

verses.sloka: स बद्धो वाग्भिः अग्र्याभिः अभितुष्टाव वै सुरौ ।इन्द्रम् इन्द्र अनुजम् चैव यथावत् मुनि पुत्रकः ॥१-६२-२५॥
verses.transliteration: sa baddho vāgbhiḥ agryābhiḥ abhituṣṭāva vai surau ।indram indra anujam caiva yathāvat muni putrakaḥ ॥1-62-25॥

translations.english: Thus bound, the son of the sage praised the two devatas, Indra and Upendra with moving words.

verses.sloka: ततः प्रीतः सहस्र अक्षो रहस्य स्तुति तोषितः ।दीर्घम् आयुः तदा प्रादात् शुनःशेपाय राघव ॥१-६२-२६॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prītaḥ sahasra akṣo rahasya stuti toṣitaḥ ।dīrgham āyuḥ tadā prādāt śunaḥśepāya rāghava ॥1-62-26॥

translations.english: "O Descendant of Raghu (Rama) Indra, gratified with the secret hymn granted Sunassepha long life.

verses.sloka: स च राजा नरश्रेष्ठ यज्ञस्य च समाप्तवान् ।फलम् बहु गुणम् राम सहस्राक्ष प्रसादजम् ॥१-६२-२७॥
verses.transliteration: sa ca rājā naraśreṣṭha yajñasya ca samāptavān ।phalam bahu guṇam rāma sahasrākṣa prasādajam ॥1-62-27॥

translations.english: O Foremost of men O Rama the king also obtained from the sacrifics innumerable rewards by the grace of Indra several times greater than expected.

verses.sloka: विश्वामित्रो अपि धर्मात्मा भूयः तेपे महातपाः ।पुष्करेषु नरश्रेष्ठ दश वर्ष शतानि च ॥१-६२-२८॥
verses.transliteration: viśvāmitro api dharmātmā bhūyaḥ tepe mahātapāḥ ।puṣkareṣu naraśreṣṭha daśa varṣa śatāni ca ॥1-62-28॥

translations.english: O Best among men the righteous and mighty ascetic Viswamitra also continued his austerities at Pushkara for a thousand years". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे द्विषष्टितमस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the sixtysecond sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
